system.description:
Deal [4D + (Magical Power)] physical damage. Available only when you have an [Undead] tag.

(Self: Hidden): Deal extra damage equal to + [(DEX Mod) × SR].

An offensive spell that commands an undead that is summoning a follower to swing down a jet-black scythe wrapped in death energy from above the enemy's head. It has the characteristic of jumping up in power when attacked by surprise.
